name: Cursor
tagline: Cursor is an AI-first code editor (a fork of VS Code) that puts GPT-4 and Claude directly into the editing experience. It can rewrite entire functions from a description, explain unfamiliar codebases, generate tests, and apply multi-file edits with a single instruction. Developers describe it as the closest thing to having a senior engineer pair-programming with you full time.
